heading: SFP Cleaner Pen
bottomHtml:
Keep your fiber optic connections in top condition with this pen-type SFP cleaner, designed for cleaning LC/MU connectors and SFP modules. This compact tool uses a dry, antistatic microfiber cloth to effectively remove dust, oils, and debris from optical interfaces without the need for solvents. With a push-click mechanism, each cleaning cycle ensures a fresh cleaning surface for every use, providing 500+ cleanings per unit.


Perfect for telecom networks, data centers, and high-performance environments, the pen-style cleaner is portable, easy to use, and ideal for quick, on-the-go cleaning. This tool is essential for maintaining signal integrity, preventing connection issues, and extending the lifespan of your optical transceivers.
